protocol_amendment.blinding_change: Replace drug-synonym overlaps in mechanism descriptions with source Target symbols joined by ChEMBL Target ID and the recorded action type. No change to structured Targets or evidence values.

protocol_amendment.budget: At most 60 live calls including all 30 initial calls. Eighteen queued reservations were never dispatched and are not live calls; all four interrupted workers are charged.

leakage_review.summary: One named Kimi rationale introduced an ACTH disease-mechanism claim absent from every supplied statement; the true drug ranked 1 named and 8 blind. This is an outside-knowledge finding, not a source-backed scientific conclusion. The explicit approved-use screen found 0 matching rationales among 690 valid-final rationales; this does not exclude implicit memorization. Seven blind-output alias flags were inspected: all used androgen, somatostatin or glucocorticoid in Target/mechanism descriptions, without identifying a compound. These generic source-synonym overlaps are not affirmative drug identifications. No blind prompt contained a recorded panel drug identity or ChEMBL ID. Unknown synonyms and preserved Target/mechanism fingerprints remain risks. The Opus blind CAH and COPD jobs have no usable reply; both juries are therefore complete on only four blind panels. Their overall gaps include this reliability difference; both-valid subset gaps are reported separately.
